visual.description: Navigation bar with search icon left, centered logo, and login/cart icons right, with a secondary horizontal nav below listing 5 menu items.
Full-viewport-width image with centered text overlay (collection title + subtitle) and two side-by-side CTA buttons at bottom center.
Two equal-width image panels side by side, each with overlaid title text and a single CTA button centered within the image.
Three equal-width editorial/press images in a row, each with a date stamp and caption text below the image.
Three equal-width product cards with a 'Sold Out' badge overlaid at bottom-right of each image, no text below visible in first row.
Continuation of the product grid with product name centered below each card and price below that, plus a 'VIEW ALL' CTA button centered below the grid.

Footer split into left column with stacked policy links and right column with newsletter signup heading, body text, email input with submit button, and social icons row; full-width payment icons and copyright below.
